Sasha (People Ops): Hey all — quick follow-up from today's all-hands (thanks everyone). Posting the live Q&A here so we have a single place for clarifications. Short TL;DR: promo window is closing this Friday, manager calibration happens next Tue/Wed, and retroactive adjustments are only for approved edge cases. Drop specific questions and managers please flag any exceptions.

Aisha (Product): Thanks Sasha. For someone promoted during hiring (lateral hire with immediate level bump), what's the effective date and is retro comp applied?

Sasha (People Ops): Good q. Effective date for promotions is the first day of the next pay cycle (Mar 1 for this window). Retro pay (backpay) is limited — only for clear measurement errors or delayed formal approvals. Manager must submit the "retro-pay request" form with justification + sign-off from Finance. We don't auto-backdate for offers unless approved.

Marco (Eng Manager): Follow-up: how should we handle an IC->manager promotion that crosses two bands? Manager calibration doc says to escalate — is there a faster path?

Sasha (People Ops): If the promotion spans bands we need 2x manager calibration: direct manager + director-level sign-off. Use the "level-exception" checklist in the shared drive and add a short note in the calibration spreadsheet. We'll prioritize these during the Tue session if you tag them with HIGH.

Eli (IC): Any change to comp bands or merit pool because of the market adjustment we heard about? Curious about timing if we get approved bumps.

Devon (CTO): We expect a small market adjustment for FY26 but it's gated on board approval. If approved, comp changes would roll with the next merit cycle (May). No surprises for current promos — those follow the promo window rules.

PeopleOpsBot: :robot_face: Policy links & forms:
- Promo process & timeline: https://redwood.example/internal/promo-process
- Retro-pay request form: https://redwood.example/internal/forms/retro-pay
- Manager calibration sheet: https://redwood.example/sheets/calibration

PeopleOpsBot: Quick snippet for manager checklist:
```
1) Confirm performance notes in Lattice
2) Fill calibration row (name, current level, proposed level, justification)
3) Attach feedback summary (3 bullets)
4) If retro-pay: attach finance sign-off
```

Aisha (Product): Thanks — where do we request exceptions for equity refresh eligibility? Some hires missed refresh windows.

Sasha (People Ops): Equity refresh exceptions are handled case-by-case. Please open a ticket to people-ops@redwood with "equity exception" in the subject and include the hire date + business justification. We'll route to Comp & Legal.

Marco (Eng Manager): Last practical q — managers running out of time for calibration meetings. Any compressed process for smaller teams?

Sasha (People Ops): If your team <6 headcount, you can use the "small-team calibration" flow: submit the compact spreadsheet and we'll batch reviews. Otherwise assume standard 30-min slots. Also office hours tomorrow 10:30–11:30 for quick raises/edge cases. @here :raised_hands:

Sasha (People Ops): I'll capture these in the FAQ doc and ping the all-hands recording. Thanks everyone — keep q's coming here or DM me for sensitive cases.
